meta.name: rds
meta.description: AWS RDS relational database service for managed databases. Use when provisioning databases, configuring backups, managing replicas, troubleshooting connectivity, or optimizing performance.

copy.tagline: 管理 AWS 关系型数据库的创建、备份与优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 AWS 上的关系型数据库
copy.tagline_en: Manage AWS relational databases: provisioning, backup, and optimization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage AWS RDS databases

howto.what: Claude 能帮你管理 AWS RDS 数据库，包括创建、修改、备份、恢复、设置只读副本、排查连接问题等。
howto.when: 当你需要操作 AWS RDS 数据库，比如创建实例、配置备份、管理副本或排查故障时。

say.text: 为我的 RDS 实例创建快照并恢复。
say.note: Claude 会提供快照和恢复命令。

say.text: 排查 RDS 连接问题，检查安全组和状态。
say.note: Claude 会给出调试步骤和命令。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you manage AWS RDS databases: create, modify, backup, restore, set up read replicas, troubleshoot connectivity, and more.
howto.when_en: When you need to provision, configure, backup, replicate, or troubleshoot AWS RDS databases.

say_en.text: Create a PostgreSQL RDS instance with db.t3.medium.
say_en.note: Claude will generate AWS CLI or boto3 commands.

say_en.text: Snapshot my RDS instance and restore it.
say_en.note: Claude provides snapshot and restore commands.
Claude gives debugging steps and commands.
